name: AML FP Suppression Models v4.0
changes_from_v3: FIX 1: Class balance corrected to ~8-12% positive rate (was 89%)
FIX 2: STR fan-out controlled — only triggering alert per account labeled TP
FIX 3: Case coverage reduced to 15% with realistic SAR rates
FIX 4: Alert-level features added (RULE_RISK_PROFILE, ACCT_ALERT_COUNT, ALERT_HOUR)
FIX 5: sample_weight='balanced' applied to all models including GBM
FIX 6: Separate ALERT-LEVEL and CASE-LEVEL models with different feature sets
FIX 7: All 6 synthetic CSVs written + file manifest at end
FIX 8: CUSTOMER_RISK_RATING, KYC fields, ACCOUNT_RISK_RATING all verified present

alert_level.purpose: Pre-triage scoring at alert creation — no case data needed

case_level.purpose: SAR escalation scoring after investigation enrichment

label_derivation.fan_out_fix: Only closest alert to STR filing date labeled TP per account
